question_text: A newly appointed director, Director Cruz, owns a consulting firm that has a contract with a government agency. Under RA 6713, what must Director Cruz do regarding this business interest?

options.text: He may retain the business as long as he does not participate in decisions affecting the contract.
He must resign from his position if he cannot divest within 60 days.
He must divest from the consulting firm within 60 days of his appointment.
He may transfer the business to a family member to avoid the conflict.
